column1: # Italian (it). Drafted 2026-11-05 and decided through the three-vendor debate (l10n/decisions/it/); ships as beta. See l10n/README.md for each field.

# percent_style has no space, as CLDR's Italian format and Android's Italian strings write it (85%). Other units take a no-break space (U+00A0): 25 km/h. decimal_style is an example of the separators.
